subtitle: When gunpowder met the Rajput charge at the edge of Hindustan

panels.shot: split wide panel, left half low-angle on Babur behind a wall of carts and cannon; right half low-angle on Rana Sanga leading an armoured cavalry mass
panels.action: Babur stands stern behind a chained cart-line bristling with cannon and matchlocks on the plain of Khanwa, while opposite him Rana Sanga urges a dense wave of Rajput horsemen forward across the dusty horizon.

dialogue.text: On a March morning at Khanwa, Babur’s gunpowder wall met Rana Sanga’s Rajput storm, and a raid on Hindustan hardened into an empire.

i18n.hi: मार्च की सुबह खानवा में बाबर की बारूदी दीवार से टकराया राणा सांगा का राजपूत तूफ़ान, और हिन्दुस्तान पर धावा एक उभरते साम्राज्य में बदल गया।

panels.shot: medium wide, Babur seated in a tent with a book, shadowy memory images of Panipat and Delhi behind him
panels.action: Inside a plain campaign tent near Agra, Babur sits cross-legged over his memoir, the Baburnama, while behind him faintly fade the silhouettes of Panipat’s smoke and the domes of newly taken Delhi.

dialogue.text: After Panipat, Babur held Delhi and Agra, yet in his own memoir he wrote like a raider, unsure if Hindustan was to be plundered and left, or ruled and remade.

i18n.hi: पानीपत के बाद बाबर के पास दिल्ली-आगरा थे, पर अपनी बाबरनामा में वह खुद को लुटेरा ही लिखता रहा – निश्चय नहीं कि हिन्दुस्तान लूटकर छोड़ देना है या बसकर बदल देना है।

panels.shot: wide landscape, distant fort-hills of Mewar with riders gathering, foreground shows a messenger racing toward Babur’s camp
panels.action: Across rugged hills and strong forts of Mewar, armoured Rajput and Afghan horsemen rally under a distant banner, while in the foreground a lone courier gallops toward Babur’s plainside camp.

dialogue.text: To the south-west, the kingdom of Mewar and its allies rose as the strongest power still unbroken, and word reached Babur that Rana Sanga was gathering a coalition on his northern frontier.

i18n.hi: दक्षिण-पश्चिम में मेवाड़ और उसके साथी मज़बूत, अब तक अटूट, और ख़बर आई कि राणा सांगा उसकी उत्तरी सरहद पर बड़ा गठबंधन जोड़ रहा है।

panels.shot: close-up on Babur’s face lit by lamplight, a wine cup set aside, a hand resting on a Qur’an
panels.action: By lamplight in his tent, Babur’s face is stern and tired as he pushes aside a covered wine cup and rests one hand on a closed Qur’an beside his writing tools.

dialogue.text: In his Baburnama he records a vow: renouncing wine before Khanwa, framing the coming campaign as a jihad, seeking resolve among his weary Central Asian and Afghan followers.

i18n.hi: बाबरनामा में वह एक नज़र लिखता है – खानवा से पहले शराब त्यागने की, आने वाली लड़ाई को जिहाद मानने की, ताकि थके-हारे मध्य एशियाई और अफ़ग़ान सिपाहियों में हौसला जगे।

panels.shot: medium shot, Babur addressing a line of Turko-Mongol officers and Afghan chiefs outside the camp
panels.action: At dawn outside the camp, Babur stands on a low mound, gesturing with a firm hand as a semi-circle of armoured Turko-Mongol officers and Afghan chiefs listen with mixed doubt and determination.

dialogue.speaker: Babur
dialogue.text: If we break here, we lose all; if we stand firm, Hindustan is ours.

i18n.hi: यहाँ टूटे, तो सब गया; डटे रहे, तो हिन्दुस्तान हमारा।

panels.shot: wide shot of Babur’s army assembling the cart wall, engineers working, artillerymen positioning guns
panels.action: On the plain near Khanwa, Babur’s men haul heavy carts into line, lash them together with chains, and emplace bronze cannon and matchlock men between the wooden bulwarks.

dialogue.text: Drawing on the Ottoman style he had seen and adapted at Panipat, Babur ordered carts chained into a firing wall, matchlocks and artillery threaded between them.

i18n.hi: पानीपत में देखी-सीखी उस्मानी शैली पर चलते हुए बाबर ने गाड़ियों को जंजीरों से बाँधकर बारूदी दीवार खड़ी की, जिनके बीच बंदूकें और तोपें जड़ दी गईं।

panels.shot: diagrammatic overhead-style wide shot, showing Babur’s center behind carts and his cavalry wings poised for tulughma flanking
panels.action: From a high vantage, Babur’s formation stretches out: a solid central line of carts and guns, while mounted wings wait loose on either side, ready to sweep around the approaching foe.

dialogue.text: Behind this wall, he prepared tulughma, the steppe flanking tactics of his Timurid forebears—light, mobile cavalry poised to curl around an enemy locked on his front.

i18n.hi: इस दीवार के पीछे उसने तूलुग़्मा सजाई – अपने तिमूरी पूर्वजों की घास के मैदान वाली घेराबंदी, हल्की फुर्तीली घुड़सवार टुकड़ियाँ जो सामने जकड़े दुश्मन के इर्द-गिर्द लिपटने को तैयार थीं।

panels.shot: low-angle medium on Rana Sanga on horseback with nobles around him, background hinting at multiple banners of allies
panels.action: Rana Sanga sits straight in the saddle in polished mail, his face intent, as Rajput and allied chiefs cluster around, their varied banners—Mewar and other houses—fluttering behind them.

dialogue.text: Across the field stood Rana Sanga of Mewar, at the head of a broad Rajput coalition with Afghan and Mewati allies, seen by many in the region as the last great counterweight to Babur.

i18n.hi: सामने मेवाड़ का राणा सांगा खड़ा था, अफ़ग़ान और मेवाती साथियों समेत चौड़ी राजपूत महासंघ की अगुवाई में, जिसे बहुतों ने बाबर के सामने आख़िरी बड़ा तोल-बराबर माना।

panels.shot: medium shot of Rajput cavalry ranks, lances and swords ready, elephants faintly in the rear
panels.action: Dense ranks of Rajput horsemen in mail and cloth-of-gold sit their horses, lances upright and curved swords at their belts, with the looming shapes of war elephants farther back in the dust.

dialogue.text: Later Mughal chroniclers remembered their charge as fierce and deep, heavy cavalry and elephants used to shattering effect in north Indian war, even as numbers in all accounts swell beyond proof.

i18n.hi: मुग़ल लेखों में उनका धावा गहरा और भयंकर याद हुआ – भारी घुड़सवार और हाथी, उत्तर भारतीय जंग में घुसकर तोड़ डालने वाले, भले ही आँकड़े हर बयान में सबूत से बढ़ जाते हों।

panels.shot: tense wide shot, the two armies facing each other at some distance under a pale morning sky
panels.action: Under a pale sky, Babur’s low cart rampart and ordered lines face the looser, brightly bedecked mass of the Rajput-led host, both armies paused before the first advance.

dialogue.text: Between them lay more than a field: two styles of war, two claims over Hindustan, and the question of whether Babur’s foothold could survive this test.

i18n.hi: दोनों के बीच सिर्फ़ एक मैदान नहीं था – दो जंग के ढंग, हिन्दुस्तान पर दो दावे, और यह सवाल कि बाबर की पकड़ इस आज़माइश में टिकेगी या नहीं।

panels.shot: dynamic low-angle shot from behind Rajput cavalry beginning their charge toward the Mughal line
panels.action: Seen from behind in a surge of hooves and dust, the Rajput cavalry begin their forward drive, lances lowered and voices raised as they close the distance to Babur’s silent carts.

dialogue.text: When the Rajput-led host advanced, it carried the momentum of older battles—shock, courage, and the expectation that a single, thunderous blow could break an enemy’s heart.

i18n.hi: जब राजपूत अगुवा फ़ौज बढ़ी, तो साथ में पुरानी लड़ाइयों की रफ़्तार भी आई – धक्का, जिगर और यह यक़ीन कि एक गरजता, एकमुश्त वार दुश्मन का दिल तोड़ देता है।

panels.shot: close shot through the gaps of the cart wall, Mughal matchlock men and gunners ready, sparks beginning at the fuses
panels.action: Framed between cart wheels, Mughal matchlock men kneel steady while gunners tend smoking fuses, the first sparks flaring at the mouths of waiting cannon.

dialogue.text: Behind the carts the new weapons waited; Babur’s memoir notes the matchlocks and artillery, their smoke and thunder timed to meet the onrush instead of riding out to meet it.

i18n.hi: गाड़ियों के पीछे नए हथियार इंतज़ार में थे; बाबरनामा में बंदूकें और तोपें दर्ज हैं, उनका धुआँ और गरज, जो दुश्मन की चढ़ाई पर ही बरसने को ठहराए गए, न कि आगे बढ़कर भिड़ने को।

panels.shot: wide, hazy battlefield shot, gun smoke veiling the ground as cavalry clash near the Mughal line
panels.action: The battlefield is veiled in rolling gun smoke as charging horsemen reel near the cart-line, some wheeling away, others pressing closer while Mughal cavalry begin to arc out on the flanks.

dialogue.text: Contemporary numbers are unreliable, but the Baburnama is clear on the effect—volleys striking advancing ranks, the field turning into a maze of smoke, noise and sudden disorder.

i18n.hi: उस ज़माने के आँकड़े भरोसेमंद नहीं, पर बाबरनामा असर पर साफ़ है – दागे गए छर्रे बढ़ती क़तारों में धँसते, और मैदान पल में धुएँ, शोर और अचानक अफ़रा-तफ़री की भूलभुलैया बनता गया।

panels.shot: dramatic high-angle shot showing Mughal cavalry wings sweeping around the Rajput host’s flanks
panels.action: From above, streams of Mughal cavalry pour out and curve around the edges of the Rajput-led formation, the tulughma movement closing like a pair of jaws on its sides and rear.

dialogue.text: As Sanga’s forces fixed on the stubborn line ahead, Babur’s wings executed tulughma, riding wide to strike flanks and rear, a steppe maneuver meeting a subcontinental host.

i18n.hi: जैसे ही सांगा की फ़ौजें सामने की हठीली लकीर में उलझीं, बाबर के परों ने तूलुग़्मा चला दिया – चौड़ा घूमकर पहलू और पिछाड़ी पर वार, घास के मैदान की चाल का टकराव देसी सेनाओं से।

panels.shot: medium shot of Rana Sanga amid the fight, signalling to his men, dust and confusion around him
panels.action: Amid dust and churning riders, Rana Sanga raises his arm to signal, his guards closing around him as the pressure of flanking attacks and the unyielding front begins to show in the confusion of his line.

dialogue.text: Later Rajput traditions would remember Sanga as wounded and betrayed, but the contemporary record from the Mughal side simply shows his coalition at Khanwa grinding against tactics it was not shaped to meet.

i18n.hi: बाद की राजपूत परंपराएँ सांगा को घायल और धोखा खाया मानेंगी, पर समकालीन मुग़ल रिकार्ड बस इतना दिखाता है कि खानवा में उसका गठबंधन ऐसी चालों से रगड़ा गया जिनसे जूझने को वह बना नहीं था।

panels.shot: wide shot showing parts of the Rajput-Afghan line breaking and withdrawing, while Mughal standards advance
panels.action: Across the haze, clusters of Rajput and Afghan warriors begin to pull back in patches, their banners turning away as Mughal standards press forward from behind the cart-line and closing wings.

dialogue.text: As hours wore on, sections of Sanga’s host buckled, withdrawals and captures rippling through the ranks; by Babur’s account, the field that had promised to crush him instead opened for pursuit.

i18n.hi: घंटे बीतते ही सांगा की फ़ौज के हिस्से टूटने लगे, पीछे हटना और क़ैदें पंक्तियों में फैलने लगीं; बाबर के कहे में वही मैदान जो उसे कुचलने वाला लगता था, पीछा करने के लिए खुल गया।

panels.shot: somber medium shot, Babur on horseback surveying the aftermath, distant heaps of discarded helmets and weapons
panels.action: Later in the day, Babur sits his horse on a rise, expression grave as he surveys a field strewn with abandoned shields, helmets and standards, his officers pointing out clusters of prisoners.

dialogue.text: In the Baburnama he framed the victory in religious terms, praising it as a jihad won, and ordered harsh measures that the same memoir records without embellishment.

i18n.hi: बाबरनामा में उसने इस फ़तह को दीन के रंग में बाँधा, इसे जीता हुआ जिहाद कहा, और सख़्त क़दमों का हुक्म दिया, जिन्हें वही यादनामा बिना सजावट दर्ज करता है।

panels.shot: distant, ethically restrained wide shot of laborers stacking skull-like round stones into a grim tower shape, Babur’s figure small on the horizon
panels.action: Far from the viewer, workers under guard stack pale, rounded forms into a rising tower shape on the plain, while Babur’s distant figure watches from horseback at the horizon, the scene stark and wordless.

dialogue.text: Following older Central Asian practice, Babur notes the raising of a skull tower after Khanwa, an image of punitive terror he chose to leave in his own account.

i18n.hi: पुरानी मध्य एशियाई रीत पर चलते हुए बाबर खानवा के बाद खोपड़ियों का मीनार उठाने का ज़िक्र करता है – दहशत की एक सज़ाई तस्वीर, जिसे उसने अपने ही खाते में छोड़ देने का फ़ैसला किया।

panels.shot: medium shot of Rana Sanga being led away by attendants toward the hills, his back to the field
panels.action: On a distant track leading toward the Aravalli hills, Rana Sanga, supported by close attendants, is shown departing the field, his shoulders squared but his gaze turned back one last time toward Khanwa.

dialogue.text: Rajput narratives, preserved much later, speak of Sanga carried from the field and planning resistance anew, but whatever his hopes, the coalition that had faced Babur at Khanwa did not re-form at that scale.

i18n.hi: राजपूत कथाएँ, जो बहुत बाद में लिखी गईं, सांगा को मैदान से उठाकर फिर से प्रतिरोध की योजना बनाते दिखाती हैं, पर जो भी इरादे रहे हों, खानवा वाला वह बड़ा गठबंधन फिर उस पैमाने पर नहीं जुड़ा।

panels.shot: interior medium shot, Babur writing in the Baburnama, a map of north India spread beside him
panels.action: Back in camp, Babur leans over his manuscript, the Baburnama, pen poised, while beside him lies an unfurled map of north India marked with rivers, cities and the line of Khanwa.

dialogue.text: After Khanwa, Babur began to write of Hindustan not as a passing venture but as a dominion, turning from raider to ruler in his own words, even as he remained steeped in steppe memories.

i18n.hi: खानवा के बाद बाबर ने हिन्दुस्तान को अब गुज़रता धावा नहीं, बल्कि अपनी रियासत की तरह लिखना शुरू किया – अपने ही शब्दों में लुटेरे से बादशाह की ओर मोड़, चाहे मन में घास के मैदानों की यादें बनी रहीं।

panels.shot: final wide shot, a temporal dissolve showing Khanwa’s plain, then faint overlays of later Mughal cities and Rajput forts enduring
panels.action: The empty plain of Khanwa stretches under a quiet sky, then faintly over it appear ghostly outlines of later Mughal cities and still-standing Rajput forts, sharing the same landscape across time.

dialogue.text: Khanwa did not end Rajput power, nor Babur’s struggles, but it fixed a direction: a battle where chained carts and flanking riders turned a fragile conquest into a state whose echoes still shape the plains of north India.

i18n.hi: खानवा ने न राजपूत शक्ति का अंत कर दिया, न बाबर की जद्दोजहद का, पर दिशा पक्की कर दी – वह जंग जहाँ जंजीरी गाड़ियाँ और घेरती सवारियाँ नाज़ुक फ़तह को ऐसे राज्य में ढाल गईं जिसकी गूँज आज भी उत्तर भारत के मैदानी इलाक़ों में सुनाई देती है।

subtitle_i18n.en: When gunpowder met the Rajput charge at the edge of Hindustan
subtitle_i18n.hi: जहाँ बारूद से टकराई राजपूतों की धावा-टुकड़ी, हिन्दुस्तान की सरहद पर
